title: Live schema changes and backfills
brief: Move through compatible schema and caller states using expand, migrate and contract. Prove a backfill converged despite races and late rows, and define acceptance and return boundaries.

neighbouring_ownership.writes: Owns import mechanics outside a live compatibility protocol.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns PostgreSQL locks, rewrites and index validity.

title: Inside CockroachDB
brief: Trace SQL data through ordered keys, ranges, local storage and replicated ownership. Explain splits, leases and replica agreement with enough detail to see why a hotspot can persist as a cluster grows.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-transactions: Owns native intents and commit/retry paths.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns SQL/KV/network work and hot-range diagnosis.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-operations: Owns health, identity and removal procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.distribution: Owns transferable replica-agreement concepts; this article develops their native range, Raft and lease application.

title: CockroachDB query work and hot ranges
brief: Locate lookups, fan-out, SQL/KV work, network movement and contention from native evidence. Weigh covering and distributed keys against write and ordering costs, and separate less work from a hot-key bottleneck.

neighbouring_ownership.query-execution: Owns general execution operators and repairs.

title: Upgrading a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Rehearse binary rollout and the cluster-version boundary. Distinguish mixed binaries from finalised compatibility, and verify application acceptance, rollback eligibility and recovery choices.

neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns general redundancy and movement budgets.
neighbouring_ownership.crdb-migration: Owns application transfer between database systems.
